description: Namur - Potentiel photovoltaïque par quartier is a dataset listed in OpenData de la commune de Namur open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Namur. Calcul du potentiel photovoltaïque par quartier sur base de la géométrie des toitures (modélisation de Namur en 3D). Les attributs pour chaque quartier sont: la production potentielle moyenne d’électricité en KWh/m².an; l’année de construction moyenne; la proportion de propriétaires (%); le revenu moyen (€). Coverage: Namur. The portal files it under Energie. Its keywords are Energie, Photovoltaïque, Quartier, Pavillon, Namur3D, Solaire. The portal shows 46 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-06-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-namur-be-portal.
